latest_publication.title: How to automate client onboarding without copying the same details five times
latest_publication.target_client_type: UK professional-services and service SMEs that re-key accepted client details across CRM, finance, file storage and delivery tools
latest_publication.industry_or_operating_context: Professional-services client onboarding, CRM-to-finance hand-offs, delivery setup and client master data
latest_publication.primary_buyer_problem: A new client is recreated across several systems, causing repeated data entry, inconsistent client details, unclear ownership and delayed delivery setup.
latest_publication.primary_search_intent: Understand how to automate client onboarding across CRM, finance, files and delivery tools without duplicating or inventing client data.
latest_publication.trend_or_durable_demand: Durable operational demand. Current ICO guidance continues to require personal data to be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary, and stresses reasonable steps to maintain accuracy and clear data sources. Those principles directly support controlled onboarding records rather than uncontrolled duplication.
latest_publication.evidence_source_and_date: ICO data minimisation and accuracy guidance checked 17 August 2026.
latest_publication.existing_article_gap: The site covers intake channels and post-call CRM updates but not the accepted-client hand-off that creates records across CRM, finance, files and delivery systems.

comparison_against_previous_12.why_meaningfully_distinct: This article begins after a client is accepted and governs creation of one trusted onboarding record plus distribution into operational systems. It does not choose an intake channel, capture sales-call outcomes or compare integration architectures.

latest_publication.original_editorial_asset: A one-record, five-destination onboarding map covering CRM, finance, file storage, delivery tools and communications, supported by five explicit stop conditions.
latest_publication.first_hand_contribution_or_limits: Uses Henry Oliver's business-analysis, data-control, consulting and automation perspective without claiming legal advice or invented client results.
latest_publication.proof_points_used_recently: The 200,000-SKU and eight-hours-to-two-minutes proof points were not reused in the article body.
